name: Grand Marché de Lomé
subtitle: The Assigamé market, the commercial heart of Lomé and the domain of the Nana-Benz traders.

facts.label: Planned new building
facts.value: Four floors, 175 shops, 107 wholesalers, 894 kiosks, 105 stalls

parts.text: The Assigamé market, the commercial heart of Lomé and the domain of the Nana-Benz traders. Its main building burned in January 2013 and a rebuilding project was launched in 2020.
